
'''Togo Shrine''' is a shrine dedicated to [[Tōgō Heihachirō|Heihachiro Togo]].

Other known shrines include the Nogi Shrine, which enshrines [[Nogi Maresuke]], and the [[Kodama Shrines]], which enshrines [[Kodama Gentarō|Gentaro Kodama]].

== Major Shrines ==
* [[Tōgō Shrine]] -    Tkkyo
* [[Togo Shrine (Hanno)]]    – Saitama
* [[Tōgō Shrine (Fukutsu)]]  - Fukutsu, Fukuoka
